svg.title: Everything you come across, in one memory
svg.desc: Articles, YouTube videos, podcasts, social videos, PDFs, screenshots, imports from Pocket and Readwise, voice memos, browser quotes and notes flow into one private memory as numbered passages. A question is answered from a podcast transcript, and the citation opens the passage at 0:09.

g.text: A cooler roof for the library
How to fix a bike chain
At the end of summer, borrowers drop off
dry seed with a short note about the parent
Podcast · A conversation with the seed librarian

off dry seed with a short note…
